summary: The core code relies throughout on files that are opened relative to a directory fd, never follow links, are private, and get replaced atomically. That means open(O_DIRECTORY|O_NOFOLLOW|O_CLOEXEC), fstatat/openat/renameat/unlinkat/mkdirat, fsync(dir), flock, st_uid==getuid() and st_mode&077 checks, realpath, lstat/S_ISLNK, st_mtim/st_ctim, statvfs, access(X_OK), /proc/self/fd, setpriority(syscall(SYS_gettid)) and TZDIR. These are concentrated in local_ini.c, preferences_storage.c, ui_preferences.c, storage_locations.c, media_archive.c, recovery.c, data_client.c, config.c and library_analysis.c, and almost every such line fails to compile on mingw/UCRT (the build uses -Werror). The design keeps plain CRT int fds on both platforms. On Windows a directory fd wraps a directory HANDLE via _open_osfhandle. The *at calls are done with NtCreateFile(RootDirectory) and with SetFileInformationByHandle FileRenameInfoEx/FileDispositionInfoEx using POSIX semantics, with fallbacks for FAT and SMB and a 2 s retry for sharing violations. All handles are non-inheritable, binary, and shared READ|WRITE|DELETE. The existing errno-based error helpers keep working because the platform functions follow the POSIX return/errno convention. The mode/uid checks become one shared "private" definition: an explicit owner SID, a protected DACL that grants only user/SYSTEM/Administrators, and an ACE scan rule. flock becomes stateless LockFileEx on 1 byte at offset 2^62. C and Python must implement both rules the same way. A critical, non-obvious blocker: GLib on Windows cannot load IANA zones, so 22 g_time_zone_new_identifier call sites (core, playout, audio, ui) must move to radios_time_zone_new(), which reads the TZif footer of a bundled share/zoneinfo tree. Python also needs that tree via PYTHONTZPATH. Path handling needs case-insensitive, separator-agnostic inside/equal checks (7 private copies today, one of them a protection bypass in storage_locations.c from "database/SDBASE"). It also needs drive/UNC-aware absolute/root rules mirrored in tools/radios_database.py, and handling for 8.3 temp names, mapped/subst drives and reparse-point classes (only name-surrogate tags count as links; OneDrive placeholders do not). data_client.c compares a relative database path that Python writes with OS-native separators, so the comparison must become separator-insensitive. The header contract (about 55 functions/macros with exact signatures), the full migration table for src/ and tests/, the test changes (fork to g_test_trap_subprocess, symlink to a junction or skip, chmod to ACL helpers, mkfifo skipped, realpath'd temp dirs) and a new test_platform.c are all in the spec.
files_touched: src/core/platform.c (new: path strings, file-info helpers, error helper, tz validation/cache)
src/core/midi.c (split portable bits from ALSA backend; owned with MIDI area)
CMakeLists.txt (add platform sources, link ntdll/advapi32/shell32, TZDIR test env)
config/radios.example.ini or config.c Windows python_command default
key_decisions: Keep plain CRT int descriptors on both OSes; Windows directory fds are directory HANDLEs wrapped by _open_osfhandle so existing code shape (gint dir, read/write/close) stays.

Implement *at functions with NtCreateFile(OBJECT_ATTRIBUTES.RootDirectory) and SetFileInformationByHandle(FileRenameInfoEx/FileDispositionInfoEx with POSIX_SEMANTICS) — true openat/renameat/unlinkat semantics, no path re-resolution; fallback to FileRenameInfo/FileDispositionInfo on FAT/exFAT/SMB.
Atomic replace/unlink retry on ERROR_SHARING_VIOLATION/LOCK_VIOLATION/ACCESS_DENIED with backoff 5..250 ms, 2000 ms budget; all platform opens share READ|WRITE|DELETE, are binary and non-inheritable.

Error convention: gint/gssize functions return -1 and set errno (Win32/NTSTATUS mapped, EWOULDBLOCK for lock contention, ELOOP for no-follow on link); gboolean/pointer functions fill G_IO_ERROR via g_io_error_from_errno; existing io_error(errno) helpers unchanged.

Only name-surrogate reparse points (symlink, junction/mount point) are RADIOS_FILE_TYPE_LINK; non-surrogate reparse points (OneDrive placeholders, dedup, WOF) are reopened normally with a file-id check.

Privacy = explicit owner SID + protected DACL (user/SYSTEM/Administrators) on creation; check = owner is user (or Administrators when member) and no allow-ACE for other SIDs carrying data/write/exec/DAC rights; volumes without persistent ACLs fail closed (ENOTSUP).
flock = stateless LockFileEx/UnlockFileEx on 1 byte at offset 0x4000000000000000 (unlock-then-lock for conversion/idempotence) — shared with Python.
Directory fsync is a successful no-op on Windows; file fsync = _commit/FlushFileBuffers.

radios_time_zone_new(): POSIX = g_time_zone_new_identifier; Windows = bundled TZif footer (POSIX TZ string) -> g_time_zone_new_identifier, cached; Windows registry zone names rejected; current rules only (no history).

realpath = GetFinalPathNameByHandleW(FILE_NAME_NORMALIZED|VOLUME_NAME_DOS) with \\?\ stripped, 8.3 expanded, upper-case drive, mapped drives as UNC; 'no link in path' rule kept as realpath(p) equals p (case-insensitive).

Path comparisons via radios_path_is_inside/radios_path_equal (Windows CompareStringOrdinal ignore-case, both separators, root-with-separator aware); project-relative paths on the wire in portable '/' form.

Graceful stop: manual-reset named event Local\RadioS-stop-<pid> plus console ctrl handler, delivered as a GSource on the main context (replaces g_unix_signal_add SIGTERM/SIGINT); GUI must also route WM_QUERYENDSESSION/WM_ENDSESSION.
radios_thread_lower_priority = SetThreadPriority(THREAD_PRIORITY_BELOW_NORMAL) on Windows, exact Linux setpriority(gettid,10) kept.
radios_platform_init(): SetErrorMode(SEM_FAILCRITICALERRORS|SEM_NOOPENFILEERRORBOX), _set_fmode(_O_BINARY), zoneinfo dir, SID cache; called from main and tests, also lazily.

Tests: fork -> g_test_trap_subprocess, symlink -> radios_platform_test_symlink (junction for dirs, g_test_skip for unprivileged file links), chmod 0600/0644 -> make_private/test_make_public, mkfifo skipped on Windows, temp dirs realpath'd (TEMP is 8.3 on this machine).
risks: IANA time zones: GLib-on-Windows cannot load them; footer approach loses historic offsets and older GLib may reject RFC 8536 extended rules (e.g. Asia/Jerusalem, America/Nuuk) — must be validated over every bundled zone.
Sharing violations from readers outside our control (Python open(), GLib g_file_get_contents, AV, indexer, OneDrive, backup agents) can exceed the 2 s retry budget and make atomic replace fail.
C/Python drift in the privacy ACL rule or lock region would lock users out (credentials rejected) or make locks ineffective; needs an interop test.

Projects on FAT32/exFAT volumes cannot pass privacy checks (fail closed); RadioS root must be NTFS and user-writable (not Program Files); Defender Controlled Folder Access may block writes under Desktop/Documents.
Mapped network drives resolve to UNC paths; hand-edited storage.ini Z:\ paths will be rejected as 'symbolic link'.
MAX_PATH: relative NtCreateFile opens succeed beyond 260 chars while GLib/CRT path calls fail unless longPathAware manifest + LongPathsEnabled — inconsistent errors deep in archive folders.
NtCreateFile/FileRenameInfoEx/FileDispositionInfoEx constants may be missing from mingw headers; must be defined locally and tested on NTFS, exFAT and SMB.
pread/pwrite emulation moves and restores the CRT file position; safe only while fds are not shared between threads.

SDBASE source digest: Python sorts WindowsPath case-insensitively and globs *.py case-insensitively; C uses strcmp/exact suffix — divergence causes SCHEMA_MISMATCH if file names ever contain upper case.
data_client database_file comparison breaks for credentials.json written on Linux unless both sides compare separator-insensitively.
NTFS LastWriteTime may update lazily for some writers; change detection by mtime is best effort (size/ChangeTime/file-id still catch replacement).
Locale: Windows users typically have Turkish regional formats via setlocale(LC_ALL,""), possibly untested by Linux developers.
cross_area_dependencies: Python shim (sdbase/_platform.py, tools/_platform.py) must implement identical LockFileEx region (offset 0x4000000000000000, length 1, unlock-then-lock, EWOULDBLOCK->BlockingIOError) for gui.lock, outbox .lock, server.lock, <db>.lock etc.

Python must create private files/dirs with the exact SDDL (O:<SID>D:P(A;;FA;;;<SID>)(A;;FA;;;SY)(A;;FA;;;BA), dirs with OICI) and use the same owner/DACL check for credentials.json, data/database-service/, outbox dirs.
Python service and GUI share the stop-event naming Local\RadioS-stop-<pid>; tests replace send_signal(SIGTERM) with SetEvent; Python process identity uses pid + GetProcessTimes creation time.
Packaging must bundle <install>\share\zoneinfo (TZif v2+) and start Python with PYTHONTZPATH pointing at it; CTest must set TZDIR for C tests and PYTHONTZPATH for Python tests.

tools/radios_database.py storage_path_check/storage_directory_check must adopt the Windows storage-folder rules of spec section 5.5 (drive/UNC absolute, upper-case drive, normpath equality, normcase realpath equality, component validity, protected dirs case-insensitive with database+SDBASE as two components).
Python should write credentials.json database_file (radios_database_setup.py:348,441,531) and other project-relative paths in .as_posix() form and compare separator-insensitively.
Python runtime_version.source_digest must sort by exact name bytes and match the .py suffix case-sensitively to agree with data_client.c installed_source_digest.
Packaging/service area: Windows python_command must resolve to bundled runtime\python\pythonw.exe (no console window); config.c maps bare python3/python when the bundled file exists.

Build area: compile platform_win32.c with _WIN32_WINNT=0x0A00, link ntdll advapi32 shell32; add -D_USE_MATH_DEFINES; manifest with activeCodePage UTF-8 and longPathAware for every exe including tests; minimum Windows 10 1903.

UI area: route WM_QUERYENDSESSION/WM_ENDSESSION to the termination path; replace reset_ui.c sh/setsid restart with radios_process_spawn_detached of a Windows launcher (--wait-for-pid); close gui lock via radios_fd_close in window.c.

Audio area: keep PulseAudio-style synthetic device ids used by routing_graph.c (radios_virtual_<id>, <sink>.monitor, <sink>_mic) or migrate stored graphs; replace /proc/asound probing in ui/preferences.c with a WASAPI query; raise audio thread priority (AvSetMmThreadCharacteristicsW); use radios_fd_pread/radios_fs_open_nofollow_path in decoder.c and radios_fs_open/radios_fd_seek for WAV recording in output.c.
MIDI area: WinMM backend replaces pipe()/poll() wake mechanism and the ALSA client:port id format; platform.h provides nothing for MIDI.
Media area (analyzer.c): adopt radios_fs_open_nofollow_path, radios_file_info_same, radios_fs_mkdirat, radios_fd_make_private and send relative_path in portable '/' form.
platform_api_needs: void radios_platform_init(void) — idempotent; Win: SetErrorMode(SEM_FAILCRITICALERRORS|SEM_NOOPENFILEERRORBOX), _set_fmode(_O_BINARY), zoneinfo dir, token-user SID cache, ntdll entry points.
gboolean radios_platform_set_io_error(GError **error, gint saved_errno, const gchar *format, ...) — G_IO_ERROR/g_io_error_from_errno, message '<prefix>: <g_strerror>', restores errno, returns FALSE.

gint radios_platform_errno_from_win32(guint32 win32_error) [G_OS_WIN32 only] — Win32 error to errno (ENOENT, EACCES, EEXIST, ENOTDIR, EISDIR, ENOTEMPTY, EXDEV, ENOSPC, EROFS, ENAMETOOLONG, EINVAL, ENOTSUP, ENOMEM, EMFILE, ELOOP, EBADF, EWOULDBLOCK, EBUSY, EIO).

Macros RADIOS_O_RDONLY/WRONLY/RDWR/APPEND/CLOEXEC/CREAT/TRUNC/EXCL/BINARY/NONBLOCK/NOFOLLOW/DIRECTORY, RADIOS_O_ACCMODE, RADIOS_AT_FDCWD(-100), RADIOS_AT_REMOVEDIR(0x200) — Win values equal to CRT _O_* where they exist (CLOEXEC=_O_NOINHERIT); NOFOLLOW/DIRECTORY only for radios_fs_*; POSIX uses glibc O_*/__O_* fallbacks.

typedef struct RadioSFileInfo { RadioSFileType type; guint64 device, inode, inode_high; gint64 size, mtime_ns, ctime_ns; guint32 nlink, attributes, reparse_tag; } with RadioSFileType {UNKNOWN, REGULAR, DIRECTORY, LINK, OTHER}; LINK = POSIX symlink or Windows name-surrogate reparse point.
gboolean radios_file_info_same(const RadioSFileInfo *a, const RadioSFileInfo *b) — device, inode, inode_high, size, mtime_ns, ctime_ns equal.
gboolean radios_file_info_is_hidden(const gchar *name, const RadioSFileInfo *info) — leading '.'; Win also HIDDEN|SYSTEM attributes.
gint radios_fs_stat(const gchar *path, gboolean follow_links, RadioSFileInfo *info) — stat/lstat; dangling links succeed when !follow_links.

gint radios_fs_open(const gchar *path, gint flags, guint mode) — open(2); NOFOLLOW on last component -> ELOOP; CREAT with (mode&077)==0 creates private object; Win CreateFileW, share R|W|D, binary, non-inheritable.
gint radios_fs_unlink(const gchar *path) — never follows; Win POSIX-semantics delete with retry; directory -> EISDIR.
gint radios_fs_rename(const gchar *from, const gchar *to) — replace semantics, POSIX rename on NTFS, fallback + 2 s retry.
gint radios_fs_mkdir_with_parents(const gchar *path, guint mode) — components created get private SD when (mode&077)==0.
gchar *radios_fs_realpath(const gchar *path, GError **error) — GetFinalPathNameByHandleW, \\?\ stripped, UNC for mapped drives, upper-case drive; NULL+ENOENT when missing.
gint radios_fs_dir_check_access(const gchar *directory, gboolean need_write) — access(R|X[|W]) replacement; Win list probe + CREATE_NEW|DELETE_ON_CLOSE write probe.
gboolean radios_fs_disk_space(const gchar *directory, gint64 *free_bytes, gint64 *total_bytes) — statvfs replacement (GetDiskFreeSpaceExW: available-to-caller, total).
gint radios_fs_open_root(const gchar *absolute_path, gchar ***components) — fd of '/', 'C:\' or '\\server\share\' plus remaining components split on both separators; '.'/'..' -> EINVAL.
gint radios_fs_open_nofollow_path(const gchar *absolute_path, gint flags, guint mode) — every component opened no-follow from the root (decoder/analyzer open_local).
gint radios_fs_openat(gint dirfd, const gchar *name, gint flags, guint mode) — openat; with a real dirfd name must be one component; Win NtCreateFile(RootDirectory).
gint radios_fs_statat(gint dirfd, const gchar *name, gboolean follow_links, RadioSFileInfo *info) — fstatat (AT_SYMLINK_NOFOLLOW when !follow_links); Win opens with FILE_READ_ATTRIBUTES only.
gint radios_fs_mkdirat(gint dirfd, const gchar *name, guint mode) — (mode&077)==0 -> private dir with inheritable ACEs.
gint radios_fs_unlinkat(gint dirfd, const gchar *name, gint flags) — flags 0 or RADIOS_AT_REMOVEDIR; never follows; POSIX semantics + retry.

gint radios_fs_renameat(gint olddirfd, const gchar *oldname, gint newdirfd, const gchar *newname) — atomic replace of file/link (not directories); Win FileRenameInfoEx(REPLACE_IF_EXISTS|POSIX_SEMANTICS|IGNORE_READONLY) relative to newdirfd, fallback FileRenameInfo, 2 s retry.
gint radios_fd_stat(gint fd, RadioSFileInfo *info) — fstat.

GPtrArray *radios_fd_list_names(gint dirfd, GError **error) — owned UTF-8 names excluding . and ..; replaces /proc/self/fd/N listing (Win GetFileInformationByHandleEx FileIdBothDirectory[Restart]Info).

gssize radios_fd_pread(gint fd, gpointer buffer, gsize count, gint64 offset) / gssize radios_fd_pwrite(gint fd, gconstpointer buffer, gsize count, gint64 offset) — 64-bit offsets; Win ReadFile/WriteFile with OVERLAPPED, file position restored.
gint64 radios_fd_seek(gint fd, gint64 offset, gint whence) (_lseeki64); gint radios_fd_truncate(gint fd, gint64 length) (_chsize_s).
gint radios_fd_sync(gint fd) — fsync / _commit; gint radios_fd_sync_dir(gint dirfd) — fsync(dir) / 0 on Windows.
gint radios_fd_close(gint fd) — releases radios_fd_lock locks (best-effort UnlockFileEx) then close; required for locked fds (gui lock in ui/window.c).

gint radios_fd_lock(gint fd, gint operation) with RADIOS_LOCK_SH=1, RADIOS_LOCK_EX=2, RADIOS_LOCK_NB=4, RADIOS_LOCK_UN=8, RADIOS_LOCK_REGION_OFFSET=0x4000000000000000, RADIOS_LOCK_REGION_LENGTH=1 — flock semantics per open file/handle; NB contention -1/EWOULDBLOCK; Win stateless LockFileEx.

gboolean radios_fd_is_private(gint fd, guint checks) / gboolean radios_fs_path_is_private(const gchar *path, gboolean follow_links, guint checks) with RADIOS_PRIVATE_OWNER (st_uid==getuid), RADIOS_PRIVATE_NO_OTHERS (mode&077==0), RADIOS_PRIVATE_EXACT_FILE_MODE (mode&0777==0600 regular) — Win owner SID + DACL rule; FALSE+EACCES/ENOTSUP.

gint radios_fd_make_private(gint fd) / gboolean radios_fs_path_make_private(const gchar *path, GError **error) — fchmod 0600/0700 | protected owner-only DACL + explicit owner; no-op if already private.
gboolean radios_path_is_absolute(const gchar *path) — POSIX '/'; Win 'X:\' or UNC; rejects '\foo', 'C:foo', '\\?\', '\\.\'.
gboolean radios_path_is_root(const gchar *path) — '/', 'X:\', '\\server\share'.

gboolean radios_path_equal(const gchar *a, const gchar *b) / gboolean radios_path_is_inside(const gchar *root, const gchar *path) — separator-unified; Win CompareStringOrdinal ignore-case; root-with-trailing-separator aware.
gchar *radios_path_normalize(const gchar *path) — g_canonicalize_filename + Win '/'->'\', upper-case drive, strip \\?\ prefixes, no trailing separator except roots.
gboolean radios_path_component_valid(const gchar *name) — single valid name; Win rejects \ : * ? " < > |, control chars, trailing dot/space, reserved device names, >255 UTF-16 units.

gchar **radios_path_split(const gchar *relative); gchar *radios_path_to_portable(const gchar *relative); gchar *radios_path_from_portable(const gchar *relative) — split on both separators; '/' wire form for project-relative paths.
gchar *radios_process_executable_path(GError **error) — /proc/self/exe | GetModuleFileNameW(NULL).
void radios_process_remember_argv(gint argc, gchar **argv); gchar **radios_process_argv(void) — replaces /proc/self/cmdline (fallback CommandLineToArgvW).
guint32 radios_process_id(void).

guint radios_process_add_termination_watch(GSourceFunc callback, gpointer data, GDestroyNotify notify); void radios_process_remove_termination_watch(guint id) — POSIX SIGTERM+SIGINT via g_unix_signal_add; Win named event Local\RadioS-stop-<pid> GSource + SetConsoleCtrlHandler.
gboolean radios_process_request_stop(guint32 pid, GError **error) — kill(SIGTERM) | OpenEventW+SetEvent; G_IO_ERROR_NOT_FOUND if no channel.

gboolean radios_process_spawn_detached(const gchar *const *argv, const gchar *working_directory, GError **error) — POSIX g_spawn_async+setsid, stdio /dev/null; Win CreateProcessW DETACHED_PROCESS|CREATE_NEW_PROCESS_GROUP|CREATE_NO_WINDOW|CREATE_UNICODE_ENVIRONMENT[|CREATE_BREAKAWAY_FROM_JOB], no handle inheritance, MSVCRT quoting.
void radios_thread_lower_priority(void) — Linux setpriority(PRIO_PROCESS, gettid, 10); Win SetThreadPriority(THREAD_PRIORITY_BELOW_NORMAL).
const gchar *radios_time_zone_directory(void) — $TZDIR else /usr/share/zoneinfo | <install>\share\zoneinfo.

gboolean radios_time_zone_identifier_exists(const gchar *identifier) — loudness_policy rule (no leading '/', no '//', no '.'/'..', Win also no '\' or ':'), regular TZif file without following links; 'UTC' TRUE.
GTimeZone *radios_time_zone_new(const gchar *identifier) — drop-in for g_time_zone_new_identifier; Win IANA via bundled TZif footer, cached, NULL if unknown.

gint radios_platform_test_symlink(const gchar *target, const gchar *link_path, gboolean directory, GError **error) — tests only; Win unprivileged symlink or junction for dirs, G_IO_ERROR_NOT_SUPPORTED for unprivileged file links.
gboolean radios_platform_test_make_public(const gchar *path, GError **error) — tests only; chmod 0644 equivalent (grant BUILTIN\Users read).
